verdicts.name: Salmon, Atlantic (farmed)
verdicts.notes: Keep this as the row that owns the bare 'salmon' alias. Farmed Atlantic is what a US shopper actually buys, and both ids re-verified (175168 cooked 206/22.1/0/12.4; 175167 raw 208/20.4/0/13.4). Raw 208 > cooked 206 is real USDA data (fat drips 13.4 -> 12.4 g while protein only concentrates 20.4 -> 22.1), not a bug. A plainer FNDDS swap is NOT possible: every FNDDS cooked salmon includes added fat (2706285 'Fish, salmon, NFS' 274 kcal/18.4 F; 2706286 'baked or broiled' 274; 2706287 'grilled' 259/16.5 F; 2706290 'steamed' 237/14.1 F; 2706288 'coated' has 7.8 g carbs) and there is no 'no added fat' salmon code, so FNDDS 'Fish, salmon, raw' 2706284 (188/20.44/0/11.16) has no matching plain cooked partner. Using it would violate pair sameness (FNDDS raw is a species mix). If the raw>cooked display bothers the user, the honest fix is a one-line note in the UI, not a different id.

verdicts.name: Scallops
verdicts.notes: Both halves are generic plain scallop; wording differs only because SR labels them differently. Cooked/raw ratio is 1.6x, which is on the high side for seared scallops (FNDDS 2706358 'Scallops, steamed or boiled' 87/15.2/4.02/0.62 is raw x1.26, verified via ?fdc=), but the SR 111 kcal / 20.5 g protein figure is the widely published cooked-scallop value, so leaving as is.

summary: Checked all 22 entries on A-E with 67 requests. Wrong: (1) Tuna in water cooked id 334194 is dead (404 x2) -> SR 173709 light-in-water drained solids, 86 kcal. (2) Halibut cooked half was missing -> SR 174201 'Atlantic and Pacific, cooked, dry heat' 111/22.5/0/1.6 found by direct id probe; default flips to cooked. (3) Shrimp raw 174210 is the phosphate-treated 'may contain additives' item (71 kcal/13.6 P) and not the same food as the cooked half -> SR 175179 'Crustaceans, shrimp, raw' 85/20.1, the matched partner of 175180. Salmon: keep farmed Atlantic (175167/175168) as the bare-'salmon' row; raw 208 > cooked 206 is genuine USDA (fat drips), and a plainer FNDDS pair is impossible because every FNDDS cooked salmon includes added fat (NFS 274, baked 274, grilled 259, steamed 237) and no 'no added fat' code exists, so FNDDS raw 2706284 has no partner; if the user's complaint is the raw>cooked display, that needs a UI note not a new id. Scallops, crab (cooked<raw, real), eggs all PASS. Added 7 verified foods: rainbow trout, catfish, swordfish, mussels, clams, canned salmon (FNDDS), albacore tuna in water. Unsure/left out: haddock (cooked 174198 verified, but Foundation raw 333374 404s on this proxy and no SR raw id found in 2 probes) and oysters. Note the proxy 404s on Foundation ids (334194, 333374) — that may be why 334194 was unverified, not because the food is gone.
